# Bundled assets

Downloaded on 2026-11-01. The A-Frame version and Roboto label font match the original page's dependencies; no new visual library was introduced.

- `aframe-1.5.0.min.js`: https://aframe.io/releases/1.5.0/aframe.min.js
- `AFRAME-LICENSE`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aframevr/aframe/v1.5.0/LICENSE
- `Roboto-msdf.json`: https://cdn.aframe.io/fonts/Roboto-msdf.json
- `Roboto-msdf.png`: https://cdn.aframe.io/fonts/Roboto-msdf.png
- `ROBOTO-LICENSE`: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/googlefonts/roboto/main/LICENSE

Keep the JavaScript bundle and its notices together. A-Frame includes its renderer and third-party code; embedded notices are retained unmodified. No separate Three.js download is required.
